content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Ghana, traditional payment platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-13|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal are often inaccessible, leaving digital creators without viable solutions to monetize their work. This guide will show you how to build a crypto store on [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-17|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-11|cloudflare]] Pages, allowing you to accept payments directly and securely without relying on conventional payment gateways. You will leverage COREMERCH's proven infrastructure, specifically Stack 02, to establish a robust online store rapidly and efficiently.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms can fail creators in regions with heavy restrictions. COREMERCH's infrastructure is built for sovereignty, allowing you to operate your store independent of any single payment platform. By using Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, you ensure your business is resilient to external pressures, keeping your revenue streams secure. The architecture is designed for low operational costs and high reliability, making it ideal for digital creators in challenging financial landscapes.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start the deployment process, gather the necessary assets: your digital products (like ebooks or courses), a domain name, and a crypto wallet to receive payments. You will also need to set up an account with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides comprehensive documentation and guides for each step of the deployment process. This preparation will streamline your experience and ensure a successful launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your Cloudflare Pages site, which serves as the front end of your store. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic and integrate your NOWPayments account for automatic payment processing. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to manage order data, ensuring you have a reliable database setup. Finally, set up your digital product delivery method, whether it's through Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, to guarantee instant access for customers once payment is confirmed.
Own your store infrastructure fully; no more platform dependency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Ensure that all configurations are correct and thoroughly test your payment process in the mainnet environment. Promote your store across your networks, emphasizing the seamless transaction experience you offer. When a customer makes a purchase, monitor the automated webhook from NOWPayments to confirm receipt of funds. This efficient system allows you to focus on creating more products rather than managing transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your first transactions, consider how to scale your operations. Utilize the insights from the Sovereign Blueprint to expand your store's capabilities, such as adding more products or optimizing your payment processes. Implement customer feedback loops to enhance user experience and explore new marketing strategies to reach a wider audience. This continuous improvement mindset will solidify your store's position as a reliable platform for digital products.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Process payments in real-time with NOWPayments and keep your revenue secure.

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Register a domain name for your store. Set up your Cloudflare Pages site. Configure Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic. Create an account with NOWPayments for crypto processing. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Set up your digital product delivery method with Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Test your payment processing on the mainnet. Launch your store and promote it to your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?
You can build a digital store for free using Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. Set up your site, configure payment processing, and deliver products directly to customers after payment confirmation.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?
Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages and Workers, offering a more robust setup deployed in 48 hours with end-to-end testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each option has its advantages, with Cloudflare Pages offering more robust features for payment processing.
What types of products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software. The infrastructure supports a wide range of digital assets, allowing you to monetize your creative work effectively.
Are there any fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction, which is significantly lower than traditional payment platforms. This makes it a cost-effective solution for processing crypto payments.
